newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes five cents down at 14.65 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes five cents down at 14.65 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell five cents to 14.65 ringgit ($5.80) a kg after sellers outnumbered buyers despite a slight overnight rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME), dealers said.
"There were more initial offerings than bids and the market fell accordingly," said a dealer. The LME closed $5 lower on Tuesday.
Buyers were from Europe and Malaysia. Turnover rose to 117 tonnes from 108 tonnes on Tuesday. The local premium against the LME was at $50 a tonne from $80 previously.
